title: Kevin Pedregosa (Extern top-6 student) presents Stripe strategy to Eric using Incorruptible's four lenses
summary: Kevin Pedregosa — one of six top-performing students selected from a 100+ cohort in Extern's Corporate Strategy Externship — presented his capstone strategic analysis of Stripe to Eric this month, evaluating the company through Incorruptible's four lenses (mission drive, governance, financial gravity, mission transmission) and recommending Stripe formalize its recurring tender offers under a standing board policy to give long-term shareholders a predictable path to liquidity while preserving Stripe's flexibility to remain private.
blockquote: For my final capstone project, I chose Stripe to explore how fintech companies stay true to their mission while navigating investor pressures. Applying Eric Ries' Incorruptible framework, I evaluated the company across four lenses: mission drive, governance, financial gravity, and mission transmission.
